title: Integrity-protected evidence chain
note: Full append-only hash-chained log with signed bundle manifests required at L2.

title: Key custody and rotation
note: KMS/HSM custody + documented rotation and compromise procedure required.

title: Verifier independence
note: Vendor-independent verification steps must be documented.

title: Minimum event fields for evidence objects
note: All four required event fields must be present.

title: Replay and duplication detection
note: SHOULD at L2; MUST at L3.

title: Controlled invocation surface
note: Network-level and identity-level controls both required.

title: Change control for enforcement layer
note: Change control on gateways, registries, evaluators, and safety kernel configs.

title: Field-level privacy protection
note: Field-level encryption or structured redaction required.

title: Auditor access governance
note: Time-boxed auditor sessions and controlled export required.

title: Kill-switch test and dual-control enforcement
note: Kill-switch tabletop plus controlled exercise annually.

title: Operator-of-Record and Approver-of-Record role definitions
note: Approver-of-Record and Evidence Custodian role definitions required.

title: Separation of duties
note: OOR and AOR must be distinct identities for higher-risk actions.
